scope: Read-only rights and credit audit of current documentary image placements across eight drafts, plus one bounded Manmohan portrait opportunity search. No downloads, no new assets, no canonical edits. Original conceptual illustrations are outside this documentary audit.

summary.rights_assurance_limit: Recorded Commons licence evidence supports reuse with its obligations; this is not a legal guarantee or an independent determination that each uploader held every underlying right.

obligations: Keep creator, source and licence links visible.
Record changes if cropped or modified later; CC BY-SA adaptations retain the applicable licence obligations.
Preserve the stamp identification, literary-text context, and later FTII-campus context. These are not film stills.
GODL attribution should remain to the named government provider; no government endorsement is implied.

targeted_attempt.subject: Manmohan Mahapatra portrait
targeted_attempt.observed: Opened Wikidata item contains biographical statements but no image statement in returned page. Search results for Commons yielded general Odisha categories or unrelated people, not a licence-verifiable portrait. No asset selected.
targeted_attempt.limit: One bounded search, not proof that no licensed portrait exists. Wikidata CC0 covers its data and does not establish a licence for an unlocated image. Prior catalogue portraits remain permission-unclear.

official_footage.status: Existing official FHF source-page link is appropriate. Prior record found no licence for local download or frame extraction; own-site Vimeo playback unverified.
official_footage.audit_action: Retain source-page link, not a still or downloaded clip. No new playback claim.

unresolved_gaps: No verified reusable Manmohan portrait or movie still obtained; current FTII photograph remains correctly contextual.
No blanket permission for Manto press-kit photographs or Ankur stills established in reused evidence. Public availability is not permission.
A creator portrait or commemorative stamp does not satisfy a request for an actual film still; no film-still clearance should be implied.
unused_assets: FTII interior formerly associated with Sadhu Meher is not currently placed.
Novel cover image is not currently placed; opening text page avoids the recorded unidentified cover-portrait artist issue.
recommendation: No canonical documentary credit correction needed from this bounded pass. Keep the unresolved Manmohan portrait/still gap explicit rather than replace contextual image with an unlicensed one.
